Segment sales / operating profit from the Q4 release segment table (three-month columns). Growth sign convention: the 2013 release / 10-Q 'Components of Revenue/Sales Growth' tables present additive components (core/existing + acquisitions + currency = total); values here are stored in the schema's deduction convention (total + acq + fx = core), i.e. acq and fx have the opposite sign to the printed table.
